name: Krishna Tandel
tagline: I build scalable REST APIs, Agentic AI pipelines, and real-time systems.
about: I'm a Python & FastAPI backend developer with 6 months of industry experience building production-grade REST APIs, JWT authentication systems, and Agentic AI pipelines using Gemini function-calling. I have designed and deployed scalable backend services with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and WebSocket integrations, and I am actively seeking a Python Backend or AI Engineer role to deliver reliable, intelligent systems.

projects.title: Entertainment Platform (Full Stack + Agentic AI)
projects.summary: A full-stack application integrating Agentic AI with an automated news pipeline and layered architecture.
projects.problem: Needed a scalable way to fetch, categorize, and serve entertainment data while integrating intelligent AI agents.
projects.decisions: Implemented Agentic AI using Gemini function-calling for multi-step reasoning, and an automated news pipeline fetching from 8 sources every 10 minutes.
projects.learned: Gained hands-on experience in building JWT auth with token rotation, TTL auto-expiry indexes, and chaining LLM tools autonomously.

projects.title: Inventory Management & Ticketing System
projects.summary: A robust system developed during an internship at IT Idol Technologies for managing inventory and tickets with real-time updates.
projects.problem: Managing inventory accurately while providing real-time ticketing notifications to users.
projects.decisions: Integrated WebSockets for real-time notifications and live data updates, backed by scalable PostgreSQL databases.
projects.learned: Learned to design and manage PostgreSQL databases and implement secure JWT-based authentication in a production setting.

projects.title: AI Agent Prototype
projects.summary: A capstone deliverable featuring a working AI agent built using NLP pipelines and prompt engineering during an IBM SkillsBuild internship.
projects.problem: Applying prompt engineering techniques and AI agent workflows to practical reasoning tasks.
projects.decisions: Utilized industry tools to develop NLP pipelines and LLM-based reasoning for the prototype.
projects.learned: Gained practical exposure to LLM-based reasoning and ML model evaluation.
